name: mutation-testing
description: Measures whether a test suite detects faults, not merely runs code. /mutation-testing:principles answers operator, mutant-state, and metric questions from the literature. /mutation-testing:setup verifies the mutation tool and writes tracked config. /mutation-testing:audit runs mutation analysis on the diff (or, with --exercised, on code the changed tests call), reports surviving mutants and why each lived, verifies source was restored, and can save survivors as findings.

operators.title: Operator set
operators.description: Your operator set for every repository: default (the tool's own defaults) or narrow (statement-block removal plus relational-operator replacement, for a cheaper run). A repository's mutation-testing config overrides it. Unset by default.

max_mutants.title: Mutant cap
max_mutants.description: Your cap on how many mutants one audit run generates, in every repository. A repository's mutation-testing config overrides it, and the audit's --max flag overrides both. Unset by default, so the effort cap applies.
